summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.08/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.08 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 21, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 4¢ higher than a week ago, 28¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.45 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.86) and the highest in Stevens Point ($4.27).
